headline: Visual Designer

experience.title: Graphic Designer
bullets: Produced 100+ digital and print creatives spanning employee engagement, branding, recruitment, onboarding, and corporate communications.
Built reusable design templates and visual systems that cut turnaround time and repetitive work.

Worked closely with HR and management stakeholders to maintain low revision cycles.
Managed print-ready files including bleed, sizing, and colour accuracy, applying strong typography, colour systems, and layout principles.
Utilized AI-assisted workflows (ChatGPT, Adobe Firefly) for ideation and exploration.

experience.title: UI/UX Designer
bullets: Designed logos, visual identity systems, and brand guidelines for early-stage businesses.
Created social campaigns, branding assets, and brochures for startups and SMBs.
Conducted usability testing and translated findings into user flows and interface usability.
Produced wireframes and prototypes for digital products.
Collaborated with developers and stakeholders on design-to-development handoff.
Used Photoshop and Illustrator for product visuals and marketing assets.
